Lila.facing: Facing is bow direction (adopted M1): bow toward camera / to image-right / to image-left / away, per Spark + angle chart. Bench files written before this rename used legacy Right/Left tokens; they mean Starboard/Port respectively and are retired.

notes.PortHip: The hip that roots the kick in Lila v10, the near (front) leg in the facing-right kick frames. Track the same hip across the pair: a kick that changes hip mid-action with no declared transfer is a continuity break.
notes.StarboardHip: The other hip, the supporting leg in Lila v10.
notes.armbands: ADOPTED 2026-10-26 (user-confirmed): two thin black buckled bands on her port upper arm, above the long black arm warmer. In a front view that arm is the VIEWER'S RIGHT. Visibility depends on perspective and facing: in a back view the same arm reads viewer's left, and in side views it may be the far arm or occluded. Absence in a frame where her port arm is not the visible/near arm is not, by itself, a missing-marker failure.
notes.traps: Bare pale legs through the cheongsam side slits are not dark legwear. Bangs cover the viewer's-right eye (her port eye); glasses sit on the viewer's-left eye (her starboard eye).

Raincoat.facing: Facing is bow direction (adopted M1): bow toward camera / to image-right / to image-left / away, per Spark + angle chart. Bench files written before this rename used legacy Right/Left tokens; they mean Starboard/Port respectively and are retired.

notes.StarboardLeg: The leg that chambers in frame 9 of generated-v2. Track it across the pair.

SadPocky.facing: Facing is bow direction (adopted M1): bow toward camera / to image-right / to image-left / away, per Spark + angle chart. Bench files written before this rename used legacy Right/Left tokens; they mean Starboard/Port respectively and are retired.
SadPocky.hard_case: Separate the black thigh strap from the navy skirt by position and shape, not by colour threshold alone. If the strap cannot be seen at this resolution, report marker_seen=false for that leg instead of guessing which leg carries it.

marker_notes.PortLeg.decal: Carrot decal plus a small bunny decal on her port upper thigh, with a pink band-aid on the knee and a white sock.
marker_notes.StarboardLeg.strap: Black thigh strap with a heart ring, on her starboard thigh. It is a separate band on the thigh, not the navy pleated skirt. The skirt hangs from the waist; the strap sits on the leg itself. Do not merge strap and skirt by colour: both are dark, and naive colour thresholding cannot separate them.

depth: depth_rank 0 is the near (front) leg, 1 is the far (back) leg. The kicking leg in the bench cases is the near leg, drawn in front, in all kick frames.
reading_rule: Entity names are Port (her left, defined by bow) and Starboard (her right, defined by bow), never image left/right. Facing is BOW direction (nose/face direction), adopted M1: bow toward camera, bow to image-right, bow to image-left, or bow away, as Spark + angle chart reports it. A mirrored marker is a FAIL, not a cosmetic swap. Right/Left are retired, not aliases.
status: M1 FROZEN 2026-10-26 (user-approved recommendations): Lila armbands adopted; facing = bow direction ADOPTED (supersedes viewer-side candidate); named-set proportions OUT of M1 scope, to M2 calibration; mirrored-guard case dropped (see M1-PLAN M1.5a). Sources: locked sheets lila.md (2026-09-28) and sadpocky.md (2026-09-26) only.

vocabulary.bow: The character's facing direction, defined by the nose/face. Bow is forward, stern is backward (back of head). Facing is bow direction, not image left/right.
vocabulary.stern: Opposite bow, the back of the character.
vocabulary.port: The character's LEFT side when facing the bow, exactly as on a boat. Port is intrinsic to the character: it is the same leg/arm in every view, even when it appears on the image right in one view and the image left in another. PortLeg = her port leg, PortArm = her port arm.
vocabulary.starboard: The character's RIGHT side when facing the bow. StarboardLeg = her starboard leg, StarboardArm = her starboard arm. Starboard and port never swap with camera angle; only their image position does.
vocabulary.legacy_alias: RETIRED 2026-10-26: Right/Left are no longer aliases. The language is Port/Starboard only. Earlier bench tokens reading StarboardLeg/PortLeg mean StarboardLeg/PortLeg and are historical records, not current language.

planes.sagittal: Vertical plane dividing port from starboard, containing the bow-stern axis. Movement in the sagittal plane is forward/backward along bow-stern: a front kick extending toward the bow, a profile view, a leg chambering forward. Bench kicks (Lila v10, SadPocky v2/v6, Raincoat) are sagittal-plane kicks.
planes.coronal: Vertical plane dividing bow from stern, containing the port-starboard axis. Movement in the coronal plane is sideways, port-to-starboard: a side kick extending sideways, a frontal view with a leg moving laterally. A coronal-plane leg change is not the same defect as a sagittal-plane leg change.
planes.axial: Horizontal plane dividing top from bottom, viewed from above/below. Movement in the axial plane is rotation around the vertical axis: turning, spinning, a top-down view. Axial movement changes bow direction without changing port/starboard identity.

vocabulary.depth_note: Near/far (depth_rank) is a camera-relative signal, not a port/starboard signal. The near leg is the one drawn over the other at a crossing, whichever side (port or starboard) it happens to be in that view.
vocabulary.bounded_context_foot: Foot, Shoe, and Sock are the same bounded context for movement: one foot area at the end of a leg, not three entities. Shoe/sock/boot masks merge into that foot area before linking to a leg.
vocabulary.out_of_scope_fall: NOT tracked in this phase: a walking character slips, falls, the starboard leg moves superior to the torso, the starboard shoe detaches and continues upward while the character lies on the ground. Detached-shoe and leg-superior-to-torso movement are out of scope; they would need a detached-object entity and their own bench case.
vocabulary.proportions_scope: OUT of M1 scope (user-approved 2026-10-26): named-set proportions (e.g. strap share of leg, marker relative position) are not calibrated in M1; M1 checker uses roles, lengths, arcs, and DL. Proportion calibration is M2 work.
